title: Making friends
examples: What should I say if I want to play with a group?
How can I use kind words when someone is sad?
What if they say no when I ask to play?

explain.say: Sometimes you see children playing. You may want to play too.
Walk over and smile. Then ask, Can I play too?
If they say yes, ask, What are the rules? Then you can play the same way.
If they say no, that is okay. You can say, Maybe later. Then play nearby.
Kind words help friends feel good. You can say, Good job, or, I like your tower.

draw.text: Kind words: Good job. I like your tower.

explain.say: If someone falls over, ask, Are you okay? This shows that you care.

faq.q: What if I ask to play and they say no?
faq.a: That is okay. You can say, Maybe later. Then you can play near them, or find another game.
asks: What do I do if they say no?
Should I keep asking if they say no?

faq.q: What are some other things I can say to join a game?
faq.a: You can say, That looks fun. Can I join in? This shows you are interested in their game.
asks: How can I join without saying 'Can I play'?
What is another way to ask to join?

faq.a: Kind words are words that make someone feel happy and safe. They are words that help others feel good inside.
asks: How do I know if my words are kind?

faq.q: Do I have to be good at games to play?
faq.a: No, you do not have to be the best player. Just wanting to play with them is the most important thing.
asks: Can I play even if I am not good?
Do I need to be good at games?

faq.q: What if I accidentally bump into someone?
faq.a: You can say, Oops, sorry. Saying sorry is a kind way to fix a small mistake.
asks: What to say if I bump someone?

facts: Asking to join a game is polite.
Saying 'Please' and 'Thank you' are kind words.
It is okay to feel sad when friends do not play with you.
Using kind words helps build friendships.

quiz.say: Kofi is building with blocks. You want to join. Tap what to say.
quiz.why: This is a kind, clear way to ask. Kofi can say yes or maybe later.

wrong.1: These words sound bossy, so ask with a question instead.
wrong.2: These words ask Kofi to look, and they skip asking to play.

quiz.say: Mei shows you her drawing. Tap a kind thing to say.
quiz.why: Saying what you like about the drawing is kind. It helps Mei feel good.

wrong.0: These words compare, and they can make Mei feel sad.
wrong.2: These words can hurt Mei’s feelings.

quiz.say: Your arm bumps Lukas’s tower. It falls down. Tap what to say.

options.show: I am sorry. Can I help?
options.say: I am sorry. Can I help?

quiz.why: Saying sorry and offering help is kind. You can build it again together.

wrong.0: These words blame the tower, so say sorry for the bump instead.
wrong.1: Lukas may feel sad, so say sorry and offer to help.
